references.caption: A view of Hearst Castle from the southwest.

One of the centerpieces of the private residence of William Randolph Hearst, is this outdoors swimming pool. It is decorated with the facade of a Roman temple as well as sculptures made of marble from the Dolomites in Italy. (Italy now bans export of Dolomite marble.)
In the present day, California runs Hearst Castle as a state park, offering several guided tours. The Neptune Pool serves as the starting point for all guided tours.

I am making Hearst Castle a stop during a drive up the Central California coast on my way to the San Francisco Bay Area.
